from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """One monthly record of housing starts found in a document."""
    reporting_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data represents (YYYY-MM)")
    total_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Starts")
    single_family_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Single-Family Housing Starts")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of the document containing this data (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    status: str | None = Field(description="Data status in the report, e.g., 'preliminary' or 'revised'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_data_points: list[HousingDataPoint]
